rules.statement: A party's signature on a settlement agreement constitutes acknowledgment and understanding of its terms, precluding subsequent claims of unawareness or misunderstanding.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The signing of the terms of settlement by the petitioner and her registered attorney-at-law would negative all the allegations raised. The petitioner cannot be heard to say that she was unaware or did not understand the terms of settlement. (2) It appears that this in fact is an after thought. As a general rule, agreement by way of compromise should not be re-opened on the ground of after thought of a party. Per Somawansa .
